errors.evidence: The y-axis label is 'Avg. Performance (%)'. The description incorrectly adds the word 'Size', stating the label is 'Avg. Performance Size (%)'.
The description claims there is a tick label at 0%, but the y-axis only has visible tick labels for 20, 40, 60, and 80.
The red 'Precision' line starts at approximately 78% for the 70m model size, not 13%.
The red 'Precision' line ends at approximately 76% for the 7.0B model size, not 35%. The line also does not show a decreasing trend; it fluctuates but remains high.
The blue 'Recall' line starts at approximately 8% for the 70m model size, not 13%.
The blue 'Recall' line ends at approximately 44% for the 7.0B model size, not 36%.
The purple 'F1-score' line ends at approximately 56% for the 7.0B model size, not 42%.
